items: 16 oz unsalted peanuts (or dry roasted peanuts)
2 packages (16 oz) white almond bark or vanilla candy melts
Layer all of the ingredients in order in a 6-quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 2 hours.
Remove the lid and stir to combine. If not all of the chocolate is melted, cover and cook for an additional 30 minutes on low.
Using a spoon or cookie scoop, scoop mounds of the clusters onto parchment-lined baking sheets.
Allow to sit at room temperature until completely set, 1 to 2 hours.
The clusters can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month. They also freeze very well!
